data.title: Everplay Group: Strong Momentum, Discount Valuation Support Buy Rating with Unchanged $380 Price Target
data.description:
James Wheatcroft, an analyst from Jefferies, maintained the Buy rating on everplay Group. The associated price target remains the same with p380.00.

James Wheatcroft has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors that highlight everplay Group’s strong operational momentum and attractive valuation. Recent flagship launches such as Hell Let Loose: Vietnam and Wardogs have significantly outperformed prior records, with Wardogs surpassing one million units sold and reaching very high concurrent user levels, prompting management to guide FY26 results meaningfully above current market expectations.

In addition, the company’s large and resilient back catalogue, fast-growing StoryToys segment, increased strategic stake in Super Media Group, and solid net cash position support both organic growth and potential value-accretive M&A and dividends. Against this backdrop, everplay still trades at a discount EV/EBITDA multiple versus peers, leading Wheatcroft to reaffirm his Buy recommendation with an unchanged price target of $380, reflecting confidence in both earnings upgrades and re-rating potential.
